## Added
- AST chunking for **TSX, CSS, SCSS, Vue** — grammar pins match tree-sitter-language-pack 1.6.2 (semble's chunking dependency); embed grows ~330 KB to ~4.4 MB. Full 63-repo/1251-query NDCG gate re-ran **PASS, benchmark-neutral** (overall delta vs semble unchanged at −0.0007).

## Changed
- **`ccx web search` embeds with the native in-process engine** on the same pinned `potion-base-8M`; the per-call `uv`/Python subprocess is deleted (`embed_driver.py`, `UVEmbedder`, CI HF-snapshot steps). Cached page vectors stay valid (pin string unchanged); offline/no-weights degrades to BM25-only; new golden-vector parity test (WASM vs Python `model2vec`, cosine ≤ 3e-8, observed).
- Embed engine parameterized by `ModelPin` (`CodePin` byte-identical to the old consts — `TestEncodeParity` + fused-search goldens unchanged); weights cache namespaced per model (one-time ~30 MB re-download of the code model).

## Fixed
- Gitignore-negated files with unmapped extensions line-chunk instead of vanishing.
- Index-cache crash safety via a per-write generation nonce across manifest/chunks/vectors (schema bump; torn caches rebuild).
- Malformed UTF-8 now decodes with Python `errors="replace"` parity end to end — including the production indexing path (review finding).
- Weight downloads bounded at 5 min so a stalled mirror can't wedge engine construction (review finding; restores the deleted uv path's first-run bound).
- Embed `Encode` honors context cancellation when queued.

## Verification
- `task test` (`-race`) green ×35 packages; `task lint` 0 issues.
- NDCG gate: PASS (artifacts on cc-notes log `5e69ae9d`).
- Review: gpt-5.6-sol finder + adversarial refuter over the full diff; both confirmed findings fixed with regression tests (`TestIndexDecodesMaximalSubsequences`, `TestDownloadTimesOut`); refuter sweep of cache-nonce orderings and `CodePin` byte-identity came back
